cells.gaps: Customs payment is electronic (ETH-006), but no source found since October 2023 says the main domestic taxes are filed and paid electronically nationwide: ETH-005 is an announced extension of e-tax and ETH-004 a mandate. No figure for revenue paid electronically.
cells.note: Reassessed 2026-11-13: ETH-006 (customs e-payment, June 2024) and ETH-003 (Amhara tax by M-PESA, July 2026) show some taxes paid electronically. Rung 4 needs the main taxes filed and paid as well, and ETH-005 (January 2024) only announces an e-tax extension and ETH-004 (May 2025) only orders bodies to accept e-payment, so neither shows it in service.
